description: This file is a build and test script for a CMake-based C++ project involving multiple components such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, and AppGateway. It manages cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring builds with coverage flags, building tests and plugins, executing tests, and generating coverage reports, specifically tailored for CI environments. It also includes routines for environment setup, dependency installation, and staging plugin shared objects.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Prints messages with a prefix for logging output.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the current environment.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Clones or checks out the specified git ref in a directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if not present; optionally checks out specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory idempotently.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if the build directory has been configured via CMakeCache.txt.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a component is installed based on prefix contents.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component via CMake.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a component via CMake without running install.

methods.name: stage_plugin_so_from_glob
methods.description: Copies a plugin shared object from a glob pattern to staging directory.

methods.name: stage_all_plugins_from_dir_best_effort
methods.description: Stages all plugin shared objects from a specified directory.
